summary_md:
# Her er de danske aktier, investorerne tror på i andet halvår

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-07-01  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Danish investor podcast reviews H1 2026, where the C25 index finished roughly flat while individual stocks saw large swings amid geopolitical turmoil, oil supply disruption and an AI-driven rally that favored US tech and semiconductors over Danish equities. The panel is constructive on European electrification/offshore-wind names (Vestas, Ørsted, NKT), banks and Boozt, cautious on Maersk's long-term shipping capacity, and skeptical of the SpaceX/AI hype and pressured discretionary consumer names. Overall mood is mixed—healthy underlying Danish business performance but capital flowing toward AI plays elsewhere.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 VWS — Vestas | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Record order intake, cost-out service programs gaining traction, European energy-security and indirect AI/datacenter demand tailwinds.

#### Reasoning

Panel is constructive and holds Vestas as a way to play European electrification and offshore wind. Margin pressure in the service division has held the stock back, but cost-out programs are showing tangible effect and margins are expected to recover; strong onshore demand (esp. US) could drive upside surprises.

#### Sell Triggers

- if service-division margins fail to recover
- if onshore order intake weakens
- if offshore auction results disappoint

> *"Så den är vi konstruktiva på och därför har vi den i portföljen."*

---

### 🟢 ORSTED — Ørsted | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Better-than-expected UK offshore auction volumes and prices plus North Sea Summit targets support European wind thesis.

#### Reasoning

The first UK offshore auction after the reset came in better on both volume and price, and the North Sea Summit set concrete year-by-year targets through 2040. Panel sees this reflected in Ørsted's share price and uses Vestas/Ørsted as exposure to European energy build-out, though European pace lags China.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Danish auction results disappoint
- if offshore project economics deteriorate
- if policy support slows

> *"Och resultaten av den var både bättre på volumen och på pris. Så vi menar att det är mer hämt det vi kan se i Örstedets kurs."*

---

### 🟢 NKT — NKT | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Top-three C25 performer lifted by electrification and energy-security demand; overweight portfolio holding.

#### Reasoning

NKT benefits from the grid-electrification and energy-security theme accelerated by the Iran conflict and shifting European energy mix. Anything tied to electrifying society becomes more interesting, and the panel has been well positioned via NKT.

#### Sell Triggers

- if electrification capex slows
- if project execution disappoints

> *"Och det är det vi har sett i NKT, vi har sett det i Örsted, vi har till del sett det i Vestas."*

---

### 🟢 BOOZT — Boozt | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Raised FY26 guidance to 7-11% constant-currency revenue growth and ~6.8% adjusted EBIT margin on strong collections and returning female customers.

#### Reasoning

Boozt lifted guidance on well-received collections, expanded assortment, recovery of female shoppers, and larger basket sizes producing scale/logistics efficiencies and lower return rates. Momentum is strong but hinges on the next collection landing as well; consumer confidence in Nordics is softening.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the next collection underperforms
- if Nordic consumer confidence deteriorates further
- if return rates rise

> *"de förväntar en omsättningsväxt på 7-11 procent i konstant valuta mot tidigare 3-8."*

---

### 🟢 DANSKE — Danske Bank | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Banks have strong earnings momentum, loan growth, benign credit quality and looser capital requirements; upgrades seen more likely than downgrades.

#### Reasoning

Underlying bank fundamentals are strong: net interest income rising with rate hikes, loan growth, low credit losses, and easing capital requirements. Danske trades near all-time high and is viewed defensively; earnings momentum should drive further gains, though valuation re-rating room is limited.

#### Sell Triggers

- if net interest income momentum reverses
- if credit quality deteriorates
- if capital requirements tighten again

> *"Där tror jag att uppjusteringar är mer troende än nedjusteringar. Nästa gång kommer regnskap, för det går underliggande riktigt bra för bankerna."*

---

### 🟡 DEMANT — Demant | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong Oticon Seal innovation and market-share gains, but uncertainty over the enterprise-audio break-up and use of proceeds caps the stock.

#### Reasoning

Demant is winning share with its innovative in-ear Oticon Seal as demographics favor hearing treatment, and the Amplifon sale looks value-creating. But the market distrusts how remaining cash will be deployed and how the residual enterprise-audio business is valued, applying a discount despite an attractive sum-of-the-parts.

#### Sell Triggers

- if management makes value-destructive M&A with proceeds
- if hearing-aid share gains stall
- if enterprise-audio weakness persists

> *"Man kan göra en riktigt god breakup case för sällskapet. Men hur mycket är det i investerarnas lommor?"*

---

### 🟡 MAERSK-B — AP Møller-Mærsk | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Large near-term guidance upgrade on Red Sea/Iran disruption lifting rates, but long-term vessel oversupply keeps most analysts cautious.

#### Reasoning

Geopolitical disruption is boosting freight rates and earnings, driving a big FY26 upgrade, and the stock is not expensive. But analysts remain mostly sell because 2027-2029 vessel deliveries threaten oversupply and falling rates; near-term rate strength doesn't fix the structural problem, and cashflow wasn't lifted as much as EBIT.

#### Sell Triggers

- if new vessel deliveries drive rate declines
- if Red Sea reopens and adds capacity
- if China-US frontloading unwinds into demand softness

> *"Men grunden till att den inte kan stiga mer, det är de här utfordringarna."*

---

### 🟡 ERIC-B — Ericsson | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Strong performer (+21% YTD, +108% over 3yrs) but Nvidia's move into custom 6G radio chips threatens Ericsson's core market.

#### Reasoning

Ericsson has been a strong All Star portfolio winner, but Nvidia signaled intent to compete in telecom equipment with custom energy-efficient 6G radio chips, encroaching on Ericsson's market. The manager is inclined to keep it as a longer-term hold while acknowledging the new competitive threat.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Nvidia gains traction in 6G radio hardware
- if telecom capex weakens
- if market share erodes

> *"För de vill i stigande grad konkurrera med traditionella telekommunikationsutstyrsutbyggare... Och det är ju Ericssons-marked."*

---

### ⛔ SPACEX — SpaceX | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 55%

Most-bought retail stock designed for FOMO; rocket-shaped price (sharp rise then fall) suggests speculative excess.

#### Reasoning

The IPO was engineered for FOMO around Elon Musk's Tesla track record, drawing heavy retail and institutional buying that pushed the price up before interest faded, producing a rocket-then-crash chart. The editor is unsurprised by the pattern and implicitly skeptical of the valuation, viewing it as risk-appetite-driven hype.

#### Sell Triggers

- if retail/FOMO buying interest fades further
- if the broader AI/tech risk-on trade reverses

> *"Nej, jag tycker att den börsavsättningen har varit designad till FOMO, alltså Fear of Missing Out."*

---

### ⛔ NKE — Nike | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Two years into an unconvincing turnaround; China sales -13%, Europe -3%, stock back to 2014 levels amid pressured US discretionary consumer.

#### Reasoning

Nike is still trying to convince investors a turnaround is near but results don't show it: sales falling in China (-13%) and Europe (-3%), only US up (+5%). Strong brand but pressured global discretionary spend, US consumers trading down, and difficult China dynamics weigh on the outlook.

#### Sell Triggers

- if China sales decline continues
- if US discretionary spending weakens further
- if turnaround milestones keep slipping

> *"de är slåda tillbaka ännu en gång på sitt tredje största marknad, Kina, där salget faller 13 procent."*

---

### 🟡 BAVA — Bavarian Nordic | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Failed Nordic Capital/Permira takeover; ex-IR chief called bid too low, but higher value hasn't materialized in the share price.

#### Reasoning

The takeover bid failed at ~60% acceptance after being deemed too low, and the ex-IR chief publicly aired internal disagreement. Since the bid, the normally volatile stock has traded stably around 180-200, below the 236-250 bid range, so the upside that dissenting investors expected has not yet materialized.

#### Sell Triggers

- if standalone value fails to close the gap to the rejected bid
- if governance/management instability continues

> *"det potentialet att de investerare som sa att budet var för lågt kunde se, det har i alla fall inte materialiserat sig i aktiekursen ännu."*

---
